#*Sail out to the Boston Harbor Islands!*
___________________________________
## Rates
**Private Sailing Charter:** From $995.00
*All Ages welcome | Price includes up to 6 people*
___________________________________
## Duration
4 hours 
___________________________________
## About
Come enjoy a 4 hour sail around the Boston Harbor! Sail out to the Boston Harbor Islands on this extended version of our tour. Enjoy sailing around some of the further islands before returning to the inner harbor for the rest of your tour. Or, design your own half day adventure, just tell our captain what you would like to do. Swimming is allowed (if not encouraged) on this option!
